title: Community Healthcare Worker Delivered Program to Address Behavioral Health in Pediatric Primary Care
official: Community Healthcare Worker Delivered Program to Address PTSD, Depression, and Disruptive Behaviors in Pediatric Primary Care
summary: This study seeks to examine whether patients who are offered linkage and coordinated care + brief mental health psychoeducation programs delivered by community health workers (CHWs) show improvements in clinical and health service delivery outcomes compared to those offered coordinated care alone.

interventions.name: Triple P Primary Care Stepping Stones (SS)

criteria:
BA Inclusion Criteria:

* A Los Angeles County Department of Health Services patient referred for CoCM services.
* Aged 12+.
* Has a PHQ score PHQ-9 score of \>= 5 OR provider refers for depression.

BA Exclusion Criteria:

* Moderate to severe intellectual disability.
* Patient in the custody of Child Protective Services or Juvenile Justice.

PCIP Inclusion Criteria:

* A Los Angeles County Department of Health Services patient referred for CoCM services.
* Aged 6+.
* A CPSS-V-SR score \>= 21 in the past year OR provider believes they may have PTSD.
* If Ages 6-11, then one parent must take part.

PCIP Exclusion Criteria:

* Moderate to severe intellectual disability.
* Patient in the custody of Child Protective Services or Juvenile Justice.

SS Inclusion Criteria:

* A Los Angeles County Department of Health Services patient referred for CoCM services.
* Aged 2+.
* Provider identifies disruptive behaviors where parenting intervention could be beneficial
* Parent would like to participate SS Exclusion Criteria
* Patient in the custody of Child Protective Services or Juvenile Justice.
